I'll also vary some books as lying flat stacks with cream page edges facing forward, and add scrolls as parchment cylinders with gilt end caps and ribbon ties. For orbs, I'll use glowing crystal spheres on small brass stands, keeping their color flat since glowing surfaces can't be painted textures.

Candles need wax cylinders with glowing flame shapes made via lathe profiles for a teardrop look, brass holders, and dripping wax details. I want to add a carved arch with runes on top as a decorative crest, but I'll stay focused on just books, scrolls, orbs, and candles rather than extra elements like a cat — keeping the anime cel-shaded style with bold ink outlines throughout.
